title: Nationwide, only about three percent of early childhood teac…

sents.en: Nationwide, only about three percent of early childhood teachers are male in the U.
sents.cn: 在全美范围内，幼儿教师中只有约百分之三是男性。

sents.en: S. Experts say this can have an impact on young children whose understanding of gender roles and identity are rapidly forming.
sents.cn: 专家表示，这会对性别角色和身份认同正在迅速形成的幼童产生影响。研究发现，接触多元化的教师对儿童有益。

sents.en: Research has found that having access to diverse teachers is beneficial for children.
sents.cn: 对最年幼的学习者而言，这意味着他们更有可能接触到不同种类的游戏和沟通方式。

sents.en: For the youngest learners, it means they are more likely to get exposed to different varieties of play and communication. It also helps them develop healthy ideas around gender.
sents.cn: 这也有助于他们形成关于性别的健康观念。

sents.en: "In our world and our society, we have very specific stereotypes（模式化形象）of gender roles," said Mindi Reich-Shapiro, an assistant professor in the teacher education department of the Borough of Manhattan Community College, and one of the authors of a recent study. "It's important for children to see other possibilities and other paths they can take."
sents.cn: "在我们所处的世界和社会里，我们对性别角色有着非常固定的模式化形象，"曼哈顿社区学院教师教育系的助理教授明迪∙赖希-夏皮罗说，她也是最近一项研究的作者之一。"让孩子们看到其他的可能性以及他们可以走的别的道路，是很重要的。"

sents.en: Despite mostly feeling supported by colleagues and family members, many of the male educators surveyed in the study reported facing social or cultural resistance in their careers as early education teachers.
sents.cn: 尽管大多感到同事和家人的支持，但研究中受访的许多男性教育者都报告说，在作为幼儿教师的职业生涯中遭遇了社会或文化层面的阻力。

sents.en: Some also reported that there were parents surprised or concerned that their child had a male teacher.
sents.cn: 一些人还报告称，有家长对自己孩子有一位男老师感到惊讶或担忧。

sents.en: And they had been advised by colleagues or other staff not to hug children.
sents.cn: 而且他们曾被同事或其他工作人员建议不要拥抱孩子。

sents.en: Reich-Shapiro and fellow researchers made several recommendations to increase male representation in the field.
sents.cn: 赖希-夏皮罗及其同行研究者提出了若干建议，以增加该领域的男性比例。

sents.en: Low pay has long been acknowledged as a major issue in the early childhood field.
sents.cn: 低收入长期以来被公认为幼儿教育领域的一个主要问题。

sents.en: Over 70% of male educators who said they intended to stay in the early education workforce noted an increased salary was a major motivating factor for them to commit to the career long-term.
sents.cn: 在表示打算留在幼儿教育工作队伍的男性教育者中，超过70%的人指出，提高薪酬是他们长期投身该职业的一大动力因素。

sents.en: The report suggests paying all early childhood educators the way elementary school teachers are paid.
sents.cn: 报告建议，应像支付小学教师那样支付所有幼儿教育工作者的薪酬。

sents.en: Cities and programs should establish support groups for male early childhood educators and provide mentoring and professional development advice for male educators and their program leaders.
sents.cn: 各城市和相关项目应当为男性幼儿教育者建立支持小组，并为男性教育者及其项目负责人提供指导与专业发展建议。

sents.en: The authors also suggest that traditional recruitment approaches for early childhood educators "do not address the gender gap in the field." They recommend providing young men opportunities to work with children through training and volunteer programs, targeting groups of men who are considering a career change, such as fathers.
sents.cn: 作者还指出，传统的幼儿教育者招聘方式"并没有解决该领域的性别差距"。他们建议通过培训和志愿者项目，为年轻男性提供与儿童共事的机会，并把目标对准那些正在考虑转行的男性群体，例如父亲们。
